ai_summary: Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited will hold its 29th Annual General Meeting to adopt FY2025-26 financial statements and declare a Rs. 2.00 per equity share dividend. A significant red flag is the proposed special resolution to approve the Managing Director's remuneration, which explicitly allows payment to exceed statutory limits and guarantees a minimum amount even when the company earns inadequate or no profits, potentially impacting future profitability and shareholder returns.
